mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.total_rooms AS totalRooms, i.booked_rooms AS bookedRooms, i.checked_in_rooms AS checkedInRooms, i.available_rooms AS availableRooms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_inventory_detail d WHERE d.inventory_id = i.id AND d.is_deleted = 0) AS detailCount FROM room_type_inventory i WHERE i.room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND i.stay_date = #{stayDate} AND i.is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE room_type_inventory SET booked_rooms = #{booked}, checked_in_rooms = #{checkedIn}, available_rooms = #{available} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND total_rooms = #{booked} + #{checkedIn} + #{available}
mapper.select: SELECT i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.total_rooms = i.booked_rooms + i.checked_in_rooms + i.available_rooms AND i.total_rooms = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_inventory_detail d WHERE d.inventory_id = i.id AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.is_deleted = 0 ) AND i.checked_in_rooms = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_inventory_detail d WHERE d.inventory_id = i.id AND d.is_occupied = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 ) AND i.booked_rooms = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.lock_room_count), 0) FROM inventory_lock_record l WHERE l.inventory_id = i.id AND l.lock_status = 'locked' AND l.is_deleted = 0 ) AND i.checked_in_rooms = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.lock_room_count), 0) FROM inventory_lock_record l WHERE l.inventory_id = i.id AND l.lock_status = 'release' AND l.is_deleted = 0 ) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_inventory_detail d WHERE d.inventory_id = i.id) = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room r WHERE r.room_type_id = i.room_type_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_inventory_detail d LEFT JOIN room r ON r.id = d.room_id LEFT JOIN checkin_record c ON c.id = d.checkin_record_id WHERE d.inventory_id = i.id AND (d.is_deleted != 0 OR r.id IS NULL OR r.is_deleted != 0 OR d.room_type_id != i.room_type_id OR r.room_type_id != i.room_type_id OR d.room_no != r.room_no OR d.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE', 'OUT_OF_SERVICE') OR d.is_occupied NOT IN (0, 1) OR (d.is_occupied = 0 AND d.checkin_record_id IS NOT NULL) OR (d.is_occupied = 1 AND (d.status != 'ACTIVE' OR c.id IS NULL OR c.is_deleted != 0 OR c.room_id != d.room_id OR c.room_type_id != i.room_type_id OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory_lock_record cl WHERE cl.order_id = c.order_id AND cl.inventory_id = i.id AND cl.lock_status = 'release' AND cl.is_deleted = 0 )))) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory_lock_record l LEFT JOIN booking_order o ON o.id = l.order_id WHERE l.inventory_id = i.id AND (l.is_deleted != 0 OR o.id IS NULL OR o.is_deleted != 0 OR o.room_type_id != i.room_type_id OR l.lock_room_count != o.room_count OR i.stay_date < DATE(o.planned_checkin_time) OR i.stay_date >= DATE(o.planned_checkout_time) OR l.lock_status != CASE o.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 'locked' WHEN 'CHECKED_IN' THEN 'release' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN 'cancel' ELSE 'invalid' END) ) FROM room_type_inventory i WHERE i.id = #{inventoryId}
